chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from some of our companions, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
When the guardian of the slain person dies, his child takes his place after him.

key_terms.مَقَامَهُ: his place, role, or legal standing
key_terms.وَلِيُّ: the legal guardian or entitled representative who holds authority in the case
key_terms.ٱلْمَقْتُولِ: the person who has been killed

ai.seo_question: Who inherits the legal position of the slain person’s guardian if the guardian dies?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding succession in the right of the slain person’s guardian. If the walī of the murdered person dies, his child assumes his legal standing afterward.
